description: Mini program parent stability PRD for Ralph. The active product focus is the parent-facing WeChat mini program, especially the real parent path: upload wrong questions, check the wrongbook, and generate/download/open the student wrong-question PDF. Bridge, Flask, Redis/RQ, worker, and PDF renderer checks are included only as supporting surfaces required to prove that the mini program path is stable end to end.
scope: Primary product scope is the WeChat mini program parent experience under miniprogram/miniprogram/.
Main mini program pages are parent-home, parent-upload, parent-wrongbook, parent-bind when child selection or invite-code setup is relevant, and parentApi.
Supporting verification may touch bridge, Flask upload task endpoints, Redis/RQ worker status, and PDF/LaTeX rendering only when required to prove the mini program upload-to-wrongbook-to-PDF journey.
Ralph must read docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-06-miniprogram-ralph-stability-loop-design.md and scripts/ralph/miniprogram_stability_loop_instructions.md before each story.
Every story must preserve the current product flow: choose child, upload wrong question, watch task status, open wrongbook, open PDF.
nonGoals: Do not redesign the website React admin/frontend experience.
Do not add new parent-facing features beyond stability, recovery, proof, and copy/visual fixes required by this PRD.
Do not reintroduce AI box selection or wrong-question-boxes routes.
Do not change payment, account approval, weekly followup, lesson planning, classroom, or website dashboard workflows.
Do not use production invite codes from memory; only use XR_TEST_CLASS_INVITE_CODE or a user-provided safe test code when a story explicitly needs binding smoke.
Do not mark real-device stability complete without WeChat DevTools or real-phone screenshot/video evidence.
stabilityDirection: The mini program must feel reliable under real parent behavior, not only under local unit tests.
Uploading should never lose the parent draft silently after crop, audio, network, timeout, 413, enqueue, worker, recognition, or PDF failure.
Wrongbook and PDF entry points must be honest about pending, failed, not-ready, download-failed, and open-failed states.
LaTeX and PDF failures must not make a successfully uploaded wrong-question record disappear.
Visual evidence is required for UI-facing stories because cramped mini program layouts often fail in ways source tests do not see.
globalRules: Read AGENTS.md, handoff.md, miniprogram/handoff.md, scripts/ralph/prd.json, scripts/ralph/progress.txt, the Ralph stability design doc, and scripts/ralph/miniprogram_stability_loop_instructions.md before each story.
Work on exactly one user story per iteration.
Use the smallest possible edit that satisfies the story; do not refactor unrelated code.
Before editing any file, read the current content.
If the story touches mini program UI, inspect visual evidence from WeChat DevTools, a real phone, or user-provided screenshots before calling the story complete.
If visual evidence is unavailable, record that as a remaining manual check and do not claim true-device visual stability.
If the story touches upload, run scripts/ralph/miniprogram_upload_stability_proof.sh in addition to the focused proof.

If the story touches PDF, LaTeX, worker, or production smoke docs, run scripts/ralph/production_upload_smoke_runbook_proof.sh plus the backend and frontend PDF/LaTeX tests listed in scripts/ralph/miniprogram_stability_loop_instructions.md.
A story can only be marked passes=true after its focused proof and relevant baseline proof pass through a temporary script.
Update scripts/ralph/progress.txt after each completed story with current status and next story.
Update handoff.md and miniprogram/handoff.md when project state changes.
Commit each completed story separately after verification.
If proof fails, do not mark the story passes=true and do not commit.
verificationBaseline: scripts/ralph/production_upload_smoke_runbook_proof.sh when PDF, LaTeX, worker, or production smoke docs are touched
python -m unittest tests.test_wrong_question_library_pdf tests.test_ai_processor_prompt -v when PDF or LaTeX is touched
cd frontend && npx tsx --test src/wrong-question-latex.test.ts src/render-wrong-question-library-pdf.test.ts src/render-wrong-question-practice-sheet-pdf.test.ts when PDF or LaTeX is touched
runInstructions: Run up to all remaining stories: scripts/ralph/run_codex_ralph.sh 9
Preferred operating mode is one story at a time so proof failures are easy to inspect.

userStories.title: Activate mini program stability Ralph proof gate
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the active Ralph queue to prove it is focused on the parent-facing mini program stability loop before any behavior hardening begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm scripts/ralph/prd.json is this mini program stability PRD with exactly nine MP-STABILITY stories.
Confirm the PRD scope states the primary product focus is miniprogram/miniprogram/ and the parent upload-to-wrongbook-to-PDF path.
Confirm scripts/ralph/miniprogram_stability_loop_instructions.md is referenced by the PRD and contains visual, upload, PDF/LaTeX, and code-review gates.
Add or update a deterministic proof if needed so the active queue cannot drift back to website frontend or generic visual-only scope.
Run scripts/ralph/miniprogram_stability_loop_proof.sh and scripts/ralph/run_codex_ralph.sh --check through a temporary script.
Do not change mini program runtime behavior in this story.
userStories.notes: Proof gate now validates the active mini program stability PRD shape, nine MP-STABILITY stories, parent upload-to-wrongbook-to-PDF scope, stability instructions reference, and visual/upload/PDF/LaTeX/code-review gate coverage.

userStories.title: Audit parent upload real-use interaction stability
userStories.description: As a parent, I need image selection, camera upload, manual boxes, tiny boxes, narrow boxes, rotation, deletion, and retry to stay stable during a realistic upload session.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit parent-upload WXML/WXSS/JS/model tests for real user operations: choose image, take photo, append image, switch current image, add box, drag box, shrink box, rotate image, delete current box, and submit.
Verify the minimum box behavior still supports small and narrow question areas and does not re-expand after save or rotation.
Verify crop/export failures identify the failed item and keep the draft.
Verify crop/export, rotation, and submit lock conflicting gestures or repeated submits.
Use visual evidence for the upload page on at least one narrow phone size or record the missing true-device visual check explicitly.
Add or update tests only where an uncovered stability risk is found.
Run scripts/ralph/miniprogram_upload_stability_proof.sh, scripts/ralph/miniprogram_visual_acceptance_guardrail_proof.sh, and git diff --check through a temporary script.
userStories.notes: Audited parent-upload WXML/WXSS/JS/model coverage for choose/take/append image, switch image, manual boxes, tiny/narrow boxes, drag/shrink, rotate, delete, crop/export failure, submit/retry, and interaction locks. Added regression that canceling camera/album selection is a no-op instead of a parent-visible upload failure. True-device upload page visual smoke remains a manual check; local narrow-screen structural guardrails passed.

userStories.title: Harden text and voice reason upload states
userStories.description: As a parent, I need text and voice reason input to be optional, recoverable, and unable to break the whole upload batch when recording is missing or audio upload fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit parent-upload reason mode, text input, voice recording, empty voice recording, upload job construction, and parentApi payload mapping.
Verify switching to voice but not recording falls back safely and can still submit.
Verify audio upload timeout, network failure, and retryable errors keep the parent draft.
Verify the mini program copy does not claim final recognition before the backend task is ready.
Verify child reason text/audio URL remains optional for image-only task acceptance.
Add or update tests only where the existing coverage misses a real failure path.
Run scripts/ralph/miniprogram_upload_stability_proof.sh and scripts/ralph/parent_upload_2_acceptance_guardrail_proof.sh through a temporary script.
userStories.notes: Audited parent-upload reason mode, text input, voice recording, empty voice recording fallback, upload job construction, and parentApi payload mapping. Hardened recorder start/onError recovery so failed recording attempts clear stale recording state and keep voice input optional. Added coverage for audio upload failure draft retention and parentApi audio timeout/network/5xx retryable mapping; guardrail now requires these fixtures. Backend task acceptance remains image-first with optional child reason text/audio URL, and upload copy stays at task accepted/background processing until backend ready.

userStories.title: Audit bridge and parentApi upload error mapping
userStories.description: As a parent on a weak network, I need bridge, parentApi, 400, 413, 502, timeout, malformed response, and retryable errors to map into stable mini program recovery states.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit miniprogram/miniprogram/utils/parentApi.js and miniprogram/backend/src parent upload proxy behavior for accepted task payloads and error metadata.
Verify website 202 task acceptance is preserved even when optional fields are missing.
Verify 400 validation failures are final and clear.
Verify 413 errors preserve draft and guide smaller crop or retake.
Verify 502 enqueue failures and network timeouts preserve retryable task metadata when available.
Verify malformed bridge or website responses do not crash the mini program.
Run bridge parent upload tests, parentApi tests, scripts/ralph/miniprogram_upload_stability_proof.sh, and git diff --check through a temporary script.
userStories.notes: Audited parentApi upload mapping and bridge parent upload proxy coverage. Bridge already preserves website 202 accepted task payloads with optional fields missing and maps 400 validation, 413 final oversize, 502 retryable enqueue, timeout, and malformed website acceptance responses into structured errors. Hardened parentApi malformed bridge 2xx upload responses so parents see the existing draft-preserving retry message instead of raw non-JSON text; 413 malformed upload responses still use the smaller-crop/retake guidance.

userStories.title: Audit upload task polling and recovery states
userStories.description: As a parent, I need pending, processing, ready, failed, stale, missing-record, and mixed task batches to remain understandable without losing accepted uploads.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit upload task persistence under the parent/openId/binding scope.
Verify page reopen restores pending accepted task ids without re-uploading cropped images.
Verify transient status request failures do not turn the whole batch failed.
Verify mixed ready/failed/pending results keep successful items visible and pending items honest.
Verify stale pending and missing-record states are represented in API or mini program recovery copy where already supported.
Verify corrupted or unavailable storage does not blank the upload page.
Run scripts/ralph/miniprogram_upload_stability_proof.sh and scripts/ralph/parent_upload_2_acceptance_guardrail_proof.sh through a temporary script.
userStories.notes: Audited parent/openId/binding scoped task persistence, page reopen recovery, transient status failures, mixed ready/failed/pending batches, corrupted storage recovery, stale pending copy, and backend missing-record state handling. Hardened parent-upload polling so website tasks with state=missing_record and status=ready remain recoverable/background instead of being marked ready and cleared; parent-upload and parent-wrongbook now surface missing-record copy, and stale pending tasks get long-running recovery copy. Parent upload guardrail now requires these fixtures.

userStories.title: Audit wrongbook refresh and PDF entry states
userStories.description: As a parent checking uploaded mistakes, I need the wrongbook to show ready, failed, still-processing, PDF-not-ready, missing-PDF, download-failed, and open-failed states honestly.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit parent-wrongbook WXML/WXSS/JS/tests and parentApi wrongbook/PDF calls.
Verify wrongbook refreshes known upload task ids before loading records and PDF metadata.
Verify failed upload tasks do not show AI success copy.
Verify background-processing uploads remain visible and explain that PDF is not ready yet.
Verify openWrongQuestionLibraryPdf handles metadata not ready, download failure, and openDocument failure with recovery copy.
Use visual evidence for wrongbook and PDF entry on at least one narrow phone size or record the missing true-device visual check explicitly.
Run scripts/ralph/miniprogram_visual_acceptance_guardrail_proof.sh, scripts/ralph/miniprogram_upload_stability_proof.sh, and git diff --check through a temporary script.
userStories.notes: Audited parent-wrongbook WXML/WXSS/JS/tests and parentApi wrongbook/PDF calls. Existing focused coverage confirms wrongbook refreshes upload task ids before records/PDF metadata, failed upload tasks do not show AI success copy, background and missing-record uploads stay visible with PDF-not-ready copy, missing pdf_url is recoverable, and openWrongQuestionLibraryPdf handles not-ready, download-failed, and open-failed states. No runtime change was needed; true-device wrongbook/PDF visual smoke remains a manual check.

userStories.title: Harden PDF and LaTeX generation stability
userStories.description: As a parent opening the wrong-question PDF, I need old LaTeX, malformed formulas, browser renderer issues, and ReportLab fallback paths to preserve readable output instead of breaking the library.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit ai_processor.py, pdf_engine.py, frontend/src/wrongQuestionLatex.js, frontend/scripts/renderWrongQuestionLibraryPdf.mjs, and frontend/scripts/renderWrongQuestionPracticeSheetPdf.mjs for the student wrong-question library path.

Verify JSON-eaten backslashes, bare LaTeX, \frac, \text, \mathbb{R}, \left, \right, roots, powers, subscripts, multi-line formulas, Chinese prose mixed with formulas, geometry records, and malformed formulas are covered by tests.
Verify invalid LaTeX is preserved as readable source and does not crash PDF generation.
Verify browser/KaTeX rendering and ReportLab fallback are both covered.
Verify worker PDF rebuild failure keeps the wrong-question record and original image visible.

Run scripts/ralph/production_upload_smoke_runbook_proof.sh, python -m unittest tests.test_wrong_question_library_pdf tests.test_ai_processor_prompt -v, frontend LaTeX/PDF renderer tests, scripts/ralph/miniprogram_upload_stability_proof.sh, and git diff --check through a temporary script.

userStories.title: Run mini program visual and true-device smoke checklist
userStories.description: As the product owner, I need Ralph to use visual ability and real mini program evidence to catch wasted space, awkward layout, clipped text, unsafe touch targets, and developer leftovers that source tests miss.
acceptanceCriteria: Inspect parent-home, parent-upload, parent-wrongbook, and parent-bind when relevant using WeChat DevTools screenshots, real-phone screenshots/video, or user-provided screenshots.
Check at least one narrow phone size such as 360x800 or 375x667.
Check touch target size, button density, wasted card space, text clipping, overlap, safe-area padding, and scroll traps.
Check for parent-facing developer leftovers such as raw IDs, debug wording, prototype wording, internal route names, and unnecessary technical pipeline copy.
If real-device or DevTools evidence is unavailable, record exact remaining manual checks in progress.txt and do not claim true-device stability.
Add or update deterministic structural tests for any layout issue found in visual review.
Run scripts/ralph/miniprogram_visual_acceptance_guardrail_proof.sh and git diff --check through a temporary script.

userStories.title: Add final mini program stability acceptance guardrail
userStories.description: As the maintainer, I need one final guardrail that proves the active mini program Ralph stability queue is complete and the upload-to-wrongbook-to-PDF path is protected.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update a final acceptance proof script for this stability PRD if the existing proof does not already check all final contracts.
The final proof must verify every MP-STABILITY story in scripts/ralph/prd.json is passes=true before reporting complete.
The final proof must verify the active PRD remains focused on the parent-facing mini program path and has not drifted into unrelated website work.
The final proof must run or require the visual acceptance guardrail, parent upload 2.0 acceptance guardrail, mini program stability loop proof, upload stability proof, and PDF/LaTeX proof commands.
The final proof must list remaining manual WeChat DevTools, real-phone, production Redis/RQ, and production PDF smoke checks instead of pretending they are automated.
Update scripts/ralph/progress.txt with final status and remaining manual smoke commands.
Run the final proof, scripts/ralph/run_codex_ralph.sh --check, and git diff --check through a temporary script.
